project.name: spark-sql-query-pipeline
project.description: Apache Spark v4.2.0 SQL engine core (stage 1): Catalyst trees, rules, logical plans and the query execution pipeline.

nodes.name: LogicalPlan.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the abstract LogicalPlan base class of Catalyst, its LeafNode/UnaryNode/BinaryNode shapes, LogicalQueryStage, and LogicalPlanIntegrity checks used to validate optimized plans. Provides attribute resolution, metadata column handling, and constraint/stat plumbing for every logical operator.
nodes.languageNotes: Scala abstract class mixing in traits (AnalysisHelper, LogicalPlanStats, QueryPlanConstraints), with helper traits and objects defined in the same file.

nodes.name: LogicalPlan
nodes.summary: Abstract base of all logical operators; extends QueryPlan and mixes in analysis helpers, stats and constraints, and offers name resolution (resolve, resolveChildren, resolveQuoted), metadata output and maxRows hooks.

nodes.name: LeafNode
nodes.summary: Logical operator with no children; reports no produced attributes and default stats via computeStats.

nodes.name: LogicalQueryStage
nodes.summary: Logical-plan leaf that wraps a physical stage (adaptive query execution) so re-optimization can see a materialized subtree.

nodes.name: UnaryNode
nodes.summary: Logical operator with exactly one child; derives constraints by propagating child constraints through its output expressions.

nodes.name: BinaryNode
nodes.summary: Marker trait for logical operators with two children (left and right).

nodes.name: OrderPreservingUnaryNode
nodes.summary: Unary logical node that preserves child ordering, exposing outputExpressions and orderingExpressions.

nodes.name: LogicalPlanIntegrity
nodes.summary: Utility object validating plan integrity: unique expression IDs, no dangling references, aggregate expression validity, and output schema consistency of optimized plans.

nodes.name: ExposesMetadataColumns
nodes.summary: Trait for logical nodes that expose hidden metadata columns, resolving conflicts between metadata and regular output names.

nodes.name: QueryExecution.scala
nodes.summary: Central driver of the SQL query execution pipeline: lazily moves a logical plan through analyzed, command-executed, normalized, cached, optimized, physical (sparkPlan) and executedPlan phases. Also handles explain output, transactions, observed metrics, shuffle cleanup mode and debug codegen.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of lazy val phases and by-name blocks (executePhase, withAbortTransactionOnFailure) so each pipeline stage is computed once on demand and timed by QueryPlanningTracker.

nodes.name: QueryExecution
nodes.summary: Holds the lazily evaluated stages of query processing: analyzed, commandExecuted, withCachedData, optimizedPlan, sparkPlan, executedPlan and toRdd, applying preparation rules before execution and rendering explain strings.

nodes.name: CommandExecutionMode
nodes.summary: Enumeration controlling whether commands are eagerly executed (ALL), skipped, or only analyzed during query execution.

nodes.name: ShuffleCleanupMode
nodes.summary: Sealed trait with DoNotCleanup, SkipMigration and RemoveShuffleFiles variants describing shuffle file cleanup after a query ends.

nodes.name: SparkOptimizer.scala
nodes.summary: Spark's concrete Optimizer, extending the Catalyst Optimizer with SQL-engine-specific rule batches such as partition pruning, dynamic pruning, Python UDF extraction, and user-defined extra optimizations.

nodes.name: SparkOptimizer
nodes.summary: Extends Optimizer to add execution-layer rule batches (early scan pushdown, pre/post-hoc batches, experimental extra optimizations) and registers non-excludable rules.

nodes.name: SparkPlan.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the physical-plan base class SparkPlan along with LeafExecNode, UnaryExecNode and BinaryExecNode traits. Implements the execute/executeColumnar/executeBroadcast contracts, subquery preparation, metrics, and driver-side collect/take helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Template-method design: final execute() wraps abstract doExecute() with prepare, subquery waiting and RDD scope handling.

nodes.name: SparkPlan
nodes.summary: Abstract physical operator extending QueryPlan: exposes partitioning and distribution requirements, row and columnar execution paths, prepare/doExecute lifecycle, SQL metrics, logical link tracking, and executeCollect/executeTake.

nodes.name: LeafExecNode
nodes.summary: Trait for physical operators without children, with produced attributes and verbose string including output.

nodes.name: UnaryExecNode
nodes.summary: Trait for single-child physical operators with an unapply extractor and verbose explain output.

nodes.name: BinaryExecNode
nodes.summary: Trait for two-child physical operators with verbose explain output including both children.

nodes.name: SparkPlanner.scala
nodes.summary: Concrete query planner that turns an optimized LogicalPlan into SparkPlan candidates by applying an ordered list of strategies, including user-provided and extension strategies, and prunes candidates.

nodes.name: SparkPlanner
nodes.summary: Planner extending SparkStrategies that defines the strategy order, collects planLater placeholders, prunes candidate plans, and offers a pruneFilterProject helper.

nodes.name: QueryPlanner.scala
nodes.summary: Defines GenericStrategy and the QueryPlanner base class that turns a logical plan into candidate physical plans by applying an ordered list of strategies, with placeholder planning via planLater and plan pruning.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Scala type parameters (PhysicalPlan <: TreeNode[PhysicalPlan]) so the planner is generic over the physical plan type; plans are produced lazily through Iterators.

nodes.name: RuleExecutor.scala
nodes.summary: Implements RuleExecutor, the batch-based engine that applies Catalyst rules to a tree either once or to a fixed point, with metrics tracking, plan change logging and plan integrity validation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a companion object with shared QueryExecutionMetering and sealed Strategy case classes (Once, FixedPoint) to model batch execution policy.

nodes.name: TreeNode.scala
nodes.summary: Core Catalyst tree abstraction: TreeNode with transform and traversal APIs, tree pattern bitsets, tags, copy and child replacement, string and JSON rendering, plus the Leaf/Unary/Binary/Ternary/Quaternary child-arity mixins.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of F-bounded polymorphism (BaseType <: TreeNode[BaseType]), self-types, Scala reflection for makeCopy and JSON, and trait mixins for fixed child arity.

nodes.name: GenericStrategy
nodes.summary: Abstract planning strategy that maps a logical plan to zero or more candidate physical plans and provides the planLater placeholder hook.

nodes.name: QueryPlanner
nodes.summary: Abstract planner that applies its strategies to a logical plan, expands planLater placeholders recursively, and prunes the resulting candidates.

nodes.name: plan
nodes.summary: Generates an iterator of physical plans by running all strategies, substituting placeholders with recursively planned children, and pruning bad candidates.

nodes.name: RuleExecutor
nodes.summary: Abstract base for rule-driven tree transformers that runs ordered batches of rules once or to a fixed point and tracks metrics and effectiveness; the companion object holds shared metering.

nodes.name: PlanChangeLogger
nodes.summary: Helper that logs per-rule plan changes, batch-level effectiveness and rule timing metrics at a configurable log level.

nodes.name: Strategy
nodes.summary: Sealed base describing how many iterations a rule batch may run (Once or FixedPoint with max iterations).

nodes.name: logRule
nodes.summary: Logs the before/after plan diff when a rule changes the plan, honoring configured rule-name filters.

nodes.name: logBatch
nodes.summary: Logs whether a rule batch changed the plan and shows the plan diff for the batch.

nodes.name: logMetrics
nodes.summary: Logs time spent, run counts and effective counts per rule from the supplied metrics.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Core loop applying each batch's rules sequentially, repeating to fixed point or max iterations, tracking rule effectiveness, timing and plan integrity validation.

nodes.name: TreeNode
nodes.summary: Base class of all Catalyst trees providing children access, traversals (foreach/map/collect), pruned transform down/up, copying with new children, tags, pattern bits and tree string/JSON rendering.

nodes.name: TreeNodeTag
nodes.summary: Typed key used to attach arbitrary metadata tags to a TreeNode.

nodes.name: AlwaysProcess
nodes.summary: Singleton condition function that always returns true, used as the default condition for pruned transforms.

nodes.name: LeafLike
nodes.summary: Trait for tree nodes with no children, fixing children to Nil.

nodes.name: UnaryLike
nodes.summary: Trait for nodes with exactly one child, supplying children, mapChildren and withNewChildrenInternal.

nodes.name: BinaryLike
nodes.summary: Trait for nodes with left and right children, supplying children and mapChildren implementations.

nodes.name: TernaryLike
nodes.summary: Trait for nodes with three children (first, second, third) and matching child mapping.

nodes.name: QuaternaryLike
nodes.summary: Trait for nodes with four children and matching child mapping.

nodes.name: MultiTransform
nodes.summary: Helper object providing a cartesian product of alternative transformation results for multiTransformDown.

nodes.name: getDefaultTreePatternBits
nodes.summary: Computes the default tree pattern bitset by OR-ing node patterns with those of its children.

nodes.name: mergeTagsFrom
nodes.summary: Copies tags from another node without overwriting tags already present.

nodes.name: childrenFastEquals
nodes.summary: Checks element-wise reference equality between two child sequences to detect unchanged children.

nodes.name: withNewChildren
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of the node with replaced children, preserving tags and origin, and short-circuiting when children are unchanged.

nodes.name: legacyWithNewChildren
nodes.summary: Reflection-based fallback that rebuilds a node with new children by mapping constructor arguments.

nodes.name: transformDownWithPruning
nodes.summary: Applies a rule top-down (pre-order) to the tree, skipping subtrees pruned by pattern bits or the rule-ineffectiveness cache.

nodes.name: transformUpWithPruning
nodes.summary: Applies a rule bottom-up (post-order), skipping pruned subtrees and marking ineffective rules.

nodes.name: transformUpWithBeforeAndAfterRuleOnChildren
nodes.summary: Bottom-up transform that runs a rule before and after child transformation for rules needing both views.

nodes.name: multiTransformDownWithPruning
nodes.summary: Top-down transform where a rule can return multiple alternatives per node, producing a lazy stream of all alternative trees.

nodes.name: makeCopy
nodes.summary: Reflectively constructs a copy of the node with new constructor arguments, handling otherCopyArgs and error reporting.

nodes.name: clone
nodes.summary: Overrides clone to deep-copy the node tree and children while retaining tags.

nodes.name: formatArg
nodes.summary: Formats a single node argument for display, truncating by configured string length.

nodes.name: argString
nodes.summary: Builds the comma-separated argument string for a node's simple or verbose description.

nodes.name: treeString
nodes.summary: Renders the tree as an indented multi-line string with options for verbosity, ids and output columns.

nodes.name: numberedTreeString
nodes.summary: Renders the tree string prefixed with per-node numbers for referencing nodes by index.

nodes.name: getNodeNumbered
nodes.summary: Looks up a node in the tree by its pre-order number.

nodes.name: generateTreeString
nodes.summary: Recursively writes this node and its children (including inner children) with ASCII tree prefixes and truncation limits.

nodes.name: jsonFields
nodes.summary: Builds the JSON field list for a node from its constructor parameters via reflection.

nodes.name: parseToJson
nodes.summary: Converts an arbitrary constructor argument (nodes, options, collections, case classes) into a JSON value.

nodes.name: shouldConvertToJson
nodes.summary: Decides whether a given value type can be converted to JSON.

nodes.name: QueryPlan.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the abstract QueryPlan base class shared by logical and physical plans, adding expression transforms, attribute rewriting, subquery-aware traversal and canonicalization on top of TreeNode. Also provides the QueryPlan companion with expression normalization helpers and a pattern bit mask object.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an F-bounded generic (PlanType <: QueryPlan[PlanType]) with a self-type annotation so transforms return the concrete plan type; caches derived values with BestEffortLazyVal.

nodes.name: QueryPlan
nodes.summary: Abstract base class of all Catalyst logical and physical plan nodes, extending TreeNode. Declares output, references and expressions, expression transform APIs, attribute rewriting, subquery traversal, canonicalization and semantic equality.

nodes.name: QueryPlan companion object
nodes.summary: Companion object with the codegen id tag, a thread-local plan id map for explain output, and helpers to normalize expression ids and predicates for canonicalization plus plan string formatting.

nodes.name: QueryPlanPatternBitMask
nodes.summary: Holds a precomputed BitSet mask covering all tree patterns below OPERATOR_START, used to separate expression patterns from operator patterns.

nodes.name: nodeWithOutputColumnsString
nodes.summary: Renders the node name with its output columns and nullability, truncating after maxColumns.

nodes.name: inputSet
nodes.summary: Computes the AttributeSet produced by all children, tolerating unresolved children.

nodes.name: missingInput
nodes.summary: Returns referenced attributes that are neither provided by children nor produced by this node, used to detect unresolved plans.

nodes.name: transformExpressionsWithPruning
nodes.summary: Applies a rule to every expression of this plan node with tree-pattern pruning, delegating to the down variant.

nodes.name: transformExpressionsDownWithPruning
nodes.summary: Applies the rule to expressions top-down with pruning conditions and rule id for ineffective-rule tracking.

nodes.name: transformExpressionsUpWithPruning
nodes.summary: Applies the rule to expressions bottom-up with pruning conditions and rule id.

nodes.name: mapExpressions
nodes.summary: Core helper that applies a function to every Expression among the node constructor arguments (recursing through Seq, Map, Option, tuples) and rebuilds the node via makeCopy if anything changed.

nodes.name: transformAllExpressionsWithPruning
nodes.summary: Transforms all expressions in the whole plan tree with pruning, combining transformWithPruning and transformExpressionsDownWithPruning.

nodes.name: transformUpWithNewOutput
nodes.summary: Bottom-up plan rewrite where the rule also returns old-to-new attribute mappings, which are propagated to ancestors so references to changed output attributes are rewritten.

nodes.name: rewriteAttrs
nodes.summary: Rewrites attribute references in this plan using the given mapping, including subquery expressions.

nodes.name: updateAttr
nodes.summary: Maps an attribute through an AttributeMap while preserving its name, qualifier and metadata.

nodes.name: updateOuterReferencesInSubquery
nodes.summary: Rewrites outer references inside subquery plans after the outer attributes change.

nodes.name: simpleStringWithNodeId
nodes.summary: Builds the one-line plan description prefixed with the operator id from the thread-local id map.

nodes.name: verboseStringWithOperatorId
nodes.summary: Produces the multi-line verbose explain block for a node with operator id, arguments, output and codegen id.

nodes.name: formattedNodeName
nodes.summary: Returns the node name decorated with operator id and whole-stage codegen id for explain output.

nodes.name: subqueriesAll
nodes.summary: Collects all subquery plans of this plan tree, including nested subqueries.

nodes.name: transformUpWithSubqueries
nodes.summary: Post-order transform that recurses into subquery plans before applying the rule to the node.

nodes.name: transformUpWithSubqueriesAndPruning
nodes.summary: Pruned bottom-up transform that also rewrites plans embedded in PlanExpression subqueries.

nodes.name: transformDownWithSubqueriesAndPruning
nodes.summary: Pruned top-down transform that descends into PlanExpression subquery plans.

nodes.name: foreachWithSubqueriesAndPruning
nodes.summary: Runs a function over every node, including subquery plans, skipping subtrees that fail the pruning condition.

nodes.name: collectFirstWithSubqueries
nodes.summary: Like collectFirst but also searches subquery plans.

nodes.name: doCanonicalize
nodes.summary: Default canonicalization: canonicalizes children and normalizes expression ids to ordinals so semantically equal plans compare equal.

nodes.name: sameResult
nodes.summary: Returns whether two plans are semantically equivalent by comparing canonicalized forms.

nodes.name: validateNodePatterns
nodes.summary: Asserts that the declared nodePatterns of a plan are consistent with the operator pattern mask.

nodes.name: normalizeExpressions
nodes.summary: Companion helper that rewrites AttributeReferences to BoundReference ordinals and canonicalizes subquery plans so expressions can be compared across plans.

nodes.name: normalizePredicates
nodes.summary: Normalizes a predicate sequence by combining with And, normalizing and splitting back into conjuncts.

nodes.name: append
nodes.summary: Appends a plan tree string with output info to a writer using truncation limits, used by explain.

nodes.name: generateFieldString
nodes.summary: Formats a named field in plan string output depending on whether the value is a collection.

nodes.name: SparkStrategies.scala
nodes.summary: Defines SparkStrategy, PlanLater and the SparkStrategies planner base class with the built-in physical planning strategies (limits, joins, aggregation, windows, streaming, Python evals, basic operators) that turn optimized logical plans into SparkPlans.
nodes.languageNotes: Scala objects nested inside an abstract class with a self-type (self: SparkPlanner =>), each extending Strategy and pattern matching on logical plan nodes via extractors.

nodes.name: SparkStrategy
nodes.summary: Abstract base for Spark physical planning strategies; binds planLater to produce PlanLater placeholders for unplanned child logical plans.

nodes.name: PlanLater
nodes.summary: Leaf physical placeholder wrapping a logical plan that the planner will replace with a real SparkPlan later; it cannot be executed.

nodes.name: SparkStrategies
nodes.summary: Abstract planner extending QueryPlanner[SparkPlan] that holds all built-in strategies as nested objects and links each produced physical plan back to its logical plan.

nodes.name: SpecialLimits
nodes.summary: Strategy planning special limit cases such as CollectLimit, TakeOrderedAndProject and global limits.

nodes.name: JoinSelection
nodes.summary: Strategy selecting the physical join (broadcast hash, shuffle hash, sort merge, broadcast nested loop, cartesian) based on hints, statistics and join type.

nodes.name: EventTimeWatermarkStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy mapping the logical EventTimeWatermark node to its physical watermark operator for streaming queries.

nodes.name: StatefulAggregationStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy planning streaming aggregations and session window aggregates with state store backed operators.

nodes.name: StreamingDeduplicationStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy planning streaming deduplication into a state-backed physical operator.

nodes.name: StreamingGlobalLimitStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy planning global limits on streaming plans, only in append-style output modes.

nodes.name: StreamingJoinStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy planning stream-stream joins into StreamingSymmetricHashJoinExec.

nodes.name: Aggregation
nodes.summary: Strategy planning aggregates into hash, object hash or sort aggregates, including distinct aggregate handling.

nodes.name: Window
nodes.summary: Strategy planning Window logical nodes into window physical operators, including Python window UDFs.

nodes.name: WindowGroupLimit
nodes.summary: Strategy planning WindowGroupLimit logical nodes into their physical operator.

nodes.name: InMemoryScans
nodes.summary: Strategy planning scans over cached in-memory relations into InMemoryTableScanExec.

nodes.name: StreamingRelationStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy planning streaming relations and streaming sources into their physical scan operators.

nodes.name: FlatMapGroupsWithStateStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy planning streaming flatMapGroupsWithState into a stateful physical operator.

nodes.name: StreamingTransformWithStateStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy planning streaming transformWithState operators, including initial state handling.

nodes.name: TransformWithStateInPySparkStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy planning transformWithState variants executed in Python.

nodes.name: FlatMapGroupsInPandasWithStateStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy planning applyInPandasWithState into its physical Python operator.

nodes.name: PythonEvals
nodes.summary: Strategy planning Python UDF evaluation nodes (Arrow, batch, aggregate UDFs) into physical eval operators.

nodes.name: SparkScripts
nodes.summary: Strategy planning script transformation nodes into script transformation physical operators.

nodes.name: Pipelines
nodes.summary: Strategy planning declarative pipeline logical nodes into physical operators.

nodes.name: BasicOperators
nodes.summary: Catch-all strategy mapping the remaining logical operators (project, filter, sort, union, sample, commands, write nodes, etc.) to physical operators.

nodes.name: extractTableNameForError
nodes.summary: Derives a user-friendly table name from a logical plan (DSv2, catalog table or named relation) for error messages.

nodes.name: WholeStageCodegenExec.scala
nodes.summary: Implements Spark SQL whole-stage code generation: the CodegenSupport produce/consume protocol, the InputAdapter leaf, the WholeStageCodegenExec operator that compiles a pipeline of operators into one Java class, and the CollapseCodegenStages rule that inserts these stages into a physical plan.
nodes.languageNotes: Scala traits provide mixin-style operator capabilities; WholeStageCodegenExec has a companion object with static helpers and a second parameter list (codegenStageId) that is excluded from case-class equality.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport
nodes.summary: Trait for physical operators that can participate in whole-stage codegen. Defines the produce/consume code generation protocol, variable evaluation helpers, and the copy-result and limit/stop-check hooks.

nodes.name: BlockingOperatorWithCodegen
nodes.summary: Mixin for blocking operators that buffer rows before producing output, disabling result copying and stop checks in the generated code.

nodes.name: InputRDDCodegen
nodes.summary: Trait for codegen leaf nodes that read rows from an input RDD iterator and generate the loop that feeds them to the parent operator.

nodes.name: InputAdapter
nodes.summary: Leaf node that hides a non-codegen SparkPlan subtree from a whole-stage codegen stage, delegating execution to its child and consuming its RDD of InternalRow.

nodes.name: WholeStageCodegenExec
nodes.summary: Physical operator (with a companion object of codegen-time metrics and field-count helpers) that compiles a subtree of codegen-capable operators into a single generated Java class, compiles it, and executes it with a fallback to the interpreted child on failure.

nodes.name: CollapseCodegenStages
nodes.summary: Physical planning Rule that decides which operators support codegen, wraps non-codegen children in InputAdapter, and inserts WholeStageCodegenExec with sequential stage IDs.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.variablePrefix
nodes.summary: Chooses a short variable-name prefix for the current operator (for example hashAgg, bhj, smj) based on its concrete type, falling back to the lowercased node name.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.produce
nodes.summary: Entry point that generates Java source for an operator by recording the parent and delegating to doProduce within executeQuery.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.prepareRowVar
nodes.summary: Builds the ExprCode for the current input row, materializing a row variable and per-column variable declarations as needed.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.consume
nodes.summary: Generates the code that passes this operator's output variables to its parent, splitting into a separate doConsume method when parameter limits and size conditions require it.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.constructDoConsumeFunction
nodes.summary: Wraps the parent's doConsume body in a generated helper function and returns the call that invokes it, to keep generated methods under the JVM size limit.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.constructConsumeParameters
nodes.summary: Computes the parameter list, argument list, and input variables for a split doConsume function from the required attributes.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.evaluateRequiredVariables
nodes.summary: Emits evaluation code only for the input variables that are actually required by the consumer.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.evaluateNondeterministicVariables
nodes.summary: Emits evaluation code for variables that depend on nondeterministic expressions so they are computed exactly once.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.needCopyResult
nodes.summary: Determines whether the produced rows must be copied before being buffered, by checking whether the parent or this node reuses row objects.

nodes.name: CodegenSupport.limitNotReachedCond
nodes.summary: Builds the boolean condition used in generated loops to stop early once all LIMIT-style operators have been satisfied.

nodes.name: InputRDDCodegen.doProduce
nodes.summary: Generates the row-iteration loop over the input RDD iterator, converting each row and calling consume on the parent.

nodes.name: InputAdapter.generateTreeString
nodes.summary: Renders the adapter in the plan tree string with a distinguishing prefix for the codegen subtree.

nodes.name: WholeStageCodegenExec.isTooManyFields
nodes.summary: Checks whether a data type's nested field count exceeds the configured whole-stage codegen limit, so codegen can be skipped for very wide schemas.

nodes.name: WholeStageCodegenExec.doCodeGen
nodes.summary: Creates a CodegenContext, produces the child pipeline, assembles the generated BufferedRowIterator subclass, and cleans and formats the source into CodeAndComment.

nodes.name: WholeStageCodegenExec.doExecute
nodes.summary: Compiles the generated code (falling back to the child plan on compile failure or oversized methods) and runs it over the input RDDs via mapPartitionsWithIndex.

nodes.name: WholeStageCodegenExec.doConsume
nodes.summary: Final consume step at the top of the stage: writes the output row to the buffered row output and checks for stop conditions.

nodes.name: WholeStageCodegenExec.generateTreeString
nodes.summary: Renders the codegen stage with its stage ID prefix in the plan tree string.

nodes.name: WholeStageCodegenExec.tryBroadcastCleanedSource
nodes.summary: Broadcasts the generated source to executors when it exceeds the configured size threshold, otherwise returns it inline.

nodes.name: CollapseCodegenStages.supportCodegen
nodes.summary: Decides whether a SparkPlan can run inside a codegen stage, rejecting plans with CodegenFallback expressions or too many input/output fields.

nodes.name: CollapseCodegenStages.insertInputAdapter
nodes.summary: Wraps operators that do not support codegen (and the children of sort-merge and shuffled-hash joins) in InputAdapter while recursing over the plan.

nodes.name: CollapseCodegenStages.insertWholeStageCodegen
nodes.summary: Recursively inserts WholeStageCodegenExec above eligible CodegenSupport operators, skipping object outputs and driver-local scan nodes, and assigns increasing stage IDs.

nodes.name: CollapseCodegenStages.apply
nodes.summary: Rule entry point that runs insertWholeStageCodegen when whole-stage codegen is enabled and the factory mode is not NO_CODEGEN, otherwise returns the plan unchanged.

nodes.name: Optimizer.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the abstract Catalyst Optimizer (a RuleExecutor over LogicalPlan) with its default rule batches, plus many logical-plan optimization rules such as predicate pushdown, column pruning, project/filter collapsing, limit pushdown, and set-operation rewrites. The file contains many more rules (about 40 rule objects here, and many more referenced from other files) than the ones individually represented in this graph.
nodes.languageNotes: Scala objects extending Rule[LogicalPlan] act as singleton rules; each overrides apply() and uses transformWithPruning with tree-pattern bitsets to skip irrelevant subtrees quickly.

nodes.name: Optimizer
nodes.summary: Abstract base optimizer extending RuleExecutor[LogicalPlan]; declares the ordered default batches (Finish Analysis, Union, Replace Operators, Operator Optimization, Join Reorder, LocalRelation, RewriteSubquery, ...), rule exclusion handling, and plan integrity validation. Subclasses such as SparkOptimizer add extra rules via extension hooks.

nodes.name: defaultBatches
nodes.summary: Builds the full ordered list of optimizer batches, each pairing a Once or FixedPoint strategy with its rules (operator push-down, combining, constant folding, join reorder, subquery rewrite, etc.).

nodes.name: nonExcludableRules
nodes.summary: Lists rule names that are required for correctness and cannot be removed via the excludedRules SQL config.

nodes.name: batches
nodes.summary: Final override that applies the spark.sql.optimizer.excludedRules setting to defaultBatches, logging warnings for non-excludable rules and dropping batches left empty.

nodes.name: FinishAnalysis
nodes.summary: Runs the finish-analysis rules (remove subquery aliases and views, replace expressions, compute current time, rewrite as-of joins and more) over the plan and recursively over subquery expressions.

nodes.name: OptimizeSubqueries
nodes.summary: Optimizes the plans nested inside subquery expressions by re-running the optimizer on them, special-casing COUNT-bug scalar subqueries, EXISTS joins and DPP subqueries, and stripping top-level sorts.

nodes.name: UpdateCTERelationStats
nodes.summary: Propagates statistics from CTE definitions to their CTERelationRef references so later cost-based rules see accurate stats.

nodes.name: EliminateDistinct
nodes.summary: Removes useless DISTINCT from aggregate expressions where it cannot change the result (e.g. MAX, MIN) or the child already guarantees uniqueness.

nodes.name: RemoveRedundantAliases
nodes.summary: Removes aliases that only rename an attribute to the same name, rewriting attribute references throughout the plan.

nodes.name: RemoveNoopOperators
nodes.summary: Eliminates operators that do nothing, such as a Project that outputs exactly its child's columns or a Window with no expressions.

nodes.name: RemoveNoopUnion
nodes.summary: Collapses Union operators that have a single effective child or whose Distinct/Deduplicate wrapper makes branches redundant.

nodes.name: LimitPushDown
nodes.summary: Pushes LIMIT operators down through unions, outer joins, and other operators to reduce data processed early.

nodes.name: PushProjectionThroughUnion
nodes.summary: Pushes a Project down into each child of a Union so projections happen before the union and columns can be pruned per branch.

nodes.name: ColumnPruning
nodes.summary: Removes columns that are never used by parent operators by inserting or narrowing Project nodes beneath Aggregate, Join, Window, Generate, Expand and similar operators.

nodes.name: CollapseProject
nodes.summary: Merges adjacent Project (and related) operators into one, inlining aliases when it does not duplicate expensive expressions, and simplifies nested extract-value expressions.

nodes.name: CollapseRepartition
nodes.summary: Combines adjacent Repartition and RepartitionByExpression operators into a single one.

nodes.name: CollapseWindow
nodes.summary: Merges adjacent Window operators that share the same partition and order spec into a single Window.

nodes.name: InferFiltersFromConstraints
nodes.summary: Infers new Filter predicates (for example IsNotNull and transitive equalities) from plan constraints and adds them to Filter and Join operators.

nodes.name: CombineUnions
nodes.summary: Flattens nested Union operators (and Distinct/Deduplicate over unions) into a single Union.

nodes.name: CombineFilters
nodes.summary: Combines two adjacent Filter operators into one by AND-ing their conditions, preserving deterministic ordering.

nodes.name: EliminateSorts
nodes.summary: Removes Sort operators that are redundant because a parent re-sorts or the ordering is irrelevant to the result.

nodes.name: PruneFilters
nodes.summary: Removes Filter operators whose condition is always true or already guaranteed by child constraints and replaces always-false filters with empty relations.

nodes.name: PushDownPredicates
nodes.summary: Combined predicate pushdown entry point that chains CombineFilters, PushPredicateThroughNonJoin and PushPredicateThroughJoin in one pass.

nodes.name: PushPredicateThroughNonJoin
nodes.summary: Pushes Filter conditions below deterministic non-join operators such as Project, Aggregate, Window, Union, Generate and Sort.

nodes.name: PushPredicateThroughJoin
nodes.summary: Pushes Filter and join conditions into the sides of a Join according to join type and moves single-side predicates below the join.

nodes.name: EliminateLimits
nodes.summary: Removes or merges redundant LIMIT operators, for example nested limits or limits above plans with smaller max row counts.

nodes.name: CheckCartesianProducts
nodes.summary: Fails the query when a join is an implicit Cartesian product and cross joins are not enabled in configuration.

nodes.name: DecimalAggregates
nodes.summary: Speeds up Sum and Average over small-precision decimals by converting to unscaled Long arithmetic.

nodes.name: ConvertToLocalRelation
nodes.summary: Evaluates Project and Filter (and Limit) applied to a LocalRelation at planning time, producing a new LocalRelation.

nodes.name: ReplaceDistinctWithAggregate
nodes.summary: Rewrites a Distinct operator as an Aggregate grouping on all output columns.

nodes.name: ReplaceDeduplicateWithAggregate
nodes.summary: Rewrites Deduplicate on a subset of columns into an Aggregate using First for the remaining columns.

nodes.name: ReplaceIntersectWithSemiJoin
nodes.summary: Rewrites INTERSECT DISTINCT into a left semi join over null-safe equality of all columns.

nodes.name: ReplaceExceptWithAntiJoin
nodes.summary: Rewrites EXCEPT DISTINCT into a left anti join with null-safe equality plus a Distinct.

nodes.name: RewriteExceptAll
nodes.summary: Rewrites EXCEPT ALL using a union with a marker column, Aggregate counting, and Generate to replicate rows.

nodes.name: RewriteIntersectAll
nodes.summary: Rewrites INTERSECT ALL using union, per-side counters, and Generate to replicate the minimum row count.

nodes.name: RemoveLiteralFromGroupExpressions
nodes.summary: Removes literal expressions from Aggregate grouping keys since they do not affect grouping.

nodes.name: GenerateOptimization
nodes.summary: Optimizes Generate operators by pruning unused outputs and pushing projections through explode-style generators.

nodes.name: Analyzer.scala
nodes.summary: Defines the Catalyst Analyzer, a RuleExecutor[LogicalPlan] that turns unresolved logical plans (UnresolvedRelation, UnresolvedAttribute, UnresolvedFunction, ...) into fully resolved plans by running ordered batches of analysis rules to fixed point. The file contains many more rules (about 45 nested rule objects plus helpers) than are individually represented in this graph; only the recognizable core ones are modeled.
nodes.languageNotes: Scala file where most rules are nested objects inside the Analyzer class, extending Rule[LogicalPlan] and overriding apply with partial-function pattern matching over plan nodes (resolveOperatorsWithPruning / transformUp). Batch order in Analyzer.batches defines the analysis pipeline.

nodes.name: SimpleAnalyzer
nodes.summary: Singleton Analyzer instance backed by a fake in-memory session catalog, used for tests and for cases where no real session catalog is needed.

nodes.name: AnalysisContext
nodes.summary: Thread-local context carried through analysis of a query, tracking the current catalog/namespace, view nesting depth, referred temp views and CTE state while resolving views and SQL functions.

nodes.name: Analyzer
nodes.summary: Main analyzer class extending RuleExecutor[LogicalPlan]. It declares the ordered rule batches (Substitution, Hints, Resolution, Post-Hoc Resolution, Cleanup, etc.) and nests the resolution rule objects that bind relations, columns, functions, subqueries, aggregates and windows.

nodes.name: executeAndCheck
nodes.summary: Public entry point that runs analysis through HybridAnalyzer under a managed AnalysisContext and session conf, returning the analyzed plan (or the plan as is if already analyzed).

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Overrides RuleExecutor.execute to run the rule batches inside a fresh AnalysisContext.

nodes.name: earlyBatches
nodes.summary: Defines the early analysis batches: Substitution (CTE, window and union cleanup), Apply Limit All, Hints, Simple Sanity Check (LookupFunctions), Keep Legacy Outputs and Unresolve Relations.

nodes.name: batches
nodes.summary: Declares the full ordered list of analyzer batches: the main fixed-point Resolution batch (relations, references, functions, aliases, subqueries, aggregates, windows, then type coercion rules) followed by Post-Hoc Resolution, Nondeterministic, UDF handling, Subquery, Cleanup and final special-command batches.

nodes.name: WindowsSubstitution
nodes.summary: Substitutes named window specifications referenced by WithWindowDefinition into unresolved window expressions.

nodes.name: ResolveAliases
nodes.summary: Assigns generated names to unnamed expressions in Project, Aggregate and grouping lists by wrapping them in Alias.

nodes.name: ResolveGroupingAnalytics
nodes.summary: Expands CUBE, ROLLUP and GROUPING SETS into Expand plus Aggregate and resolves grouping() and grouping_id() functions.

nodes.name: ResolvePivot
nodes.summary: Rewrites Pivot operators into Aggregate plans with conditional aggregate expressions per pivot value.

nodes.name: ResolveUnpivot
nodes.summary: Resolves Unpivot operators by checking column expressions and building the unpivoted output.

nodes.name: AddMetadataColumns
nodes.summary: Adds hidden metadata columns (such as _metadata or file source columns) to relations when the query references them.

nodes.name: ResolveRelations
nodes.summary: Resolves UnresolvedRelation nodes by looking up tables, views and temp views in the catalog, handling v1 and v2 catalogs, view expansion and time travel.

nodes.name: ResolveInsertInto
nodes.summary: Resolves INSERT INTO and INSERT OVERWRITE statements against v2 tables, validating partitioning, columns and write options.

nodes.name: ResolveReferences
nodes.summary: Central rule that binds UnresolvedAttribute, star expansion and other column references to child plan outputs; delegates to specialized helpers for Aggregate, Sort and Update.

nodes.name: ResolveOrdinalInOrderByAndGroupBy
nodes.summary: Replaces integer ordinals in ORDER BY and GROUP BY with the corresponding select-list expressions.

nodes.name: LookupFunctions
nodes.summary: Early sanity check that verifies every unresolved function exists in the catalog, failing fast with a clear error when not.

nodes.name: ResolveFunctions
nodes.summary: Resolves UnresolvedFunction, table functions and generators into concrete expressions using the function registry and v2 function catalogs.

nodes.name: ResolveSubquery
nodes.summary: Resolves scalar, IN, EXISTS and lateral subqueries, including outer references to the enclosing plan.

nodes.name: ResolveSQLFunctions
nodes.summary: Inlines user-defined SQL scalar functions by parsing and analyzing their bodies at call sites.

nodes.name: GlobalAggregates
nodes.summary: Turns a Project that contains aggregate functions but no GROUP BY into a global Aggregate.

nodes.name: ResolveAggregateFunctions
nodes.summary: Resolves aggregate expressions referenced in HAVING and ORDER BY clauses by pushing them into the underlying Aggregate.

nodes.name: ExtractGenerator
nodes.summary: Extracts generator expressions such as explode from select lists into explicit Generate operators.

nodes.name: ResolveGenerate
nodes.summary: Resolves Generate operators by binding the generator output attributes.

nodes.name: ExtractWindowExpressions
nodes.summary: Extracts window expressions from Project and Aggregate lists into dedicated Window operators grouped by window spec.

nodes.name: HandleNullInputsForUDF
nodes.summary: Wraps ScalaUDF calls with null checks for primitive input types so null inputs yield null results.

nodes.name: ResolveEncodersInUDF
nodes.summary: Resolves and binds input encoders of typed UDFs against their argument types.

nodes.name: ResolveNaturalAndUsingJoin
nodes.summary: Rewrites NATURAL and USING joins into regular joins with an explicit condition and projected output columns.

nodes.name: ResolveOutputRelation
nodes.summary: Checks and aligns query output with target table schema for writes, adding casts and aliases according to the store assignment policy.

nodes.name: ResolveDeserializer
nodes.summary: Resolves deserializer expressions for typed Dataset operations against the child output schema.

nodes.name: ResolveFieldNameAndPosition
nodes.summary: Resolves nested field names and positions used by ALTER TABLE column commands against the table schema.

nodes.name: ResolveQualify
nodes.summary: Resolves the QUALIFY clause by turning it into window extraction followed by a Filter and trimming helper columns.

nodes.name: ValidateEventTimeWatermarkColumn
nodes.summary: Validates that columns used by event time watermark definitions are of timestamp type.

nodes.name: EliminateEventTimeWatermark
nodes.summary: Removes EventTimeWatermark nodes from batch (non-streaming) queries.

nodes.name: EliminateSubqueryAliases
nodes.summary: Removes SubqueryAlias scoping nodes from the plan once resolution no longer needs them.

nodes.name: EliminateUnions
nodes.summary: Removes single-child Union nodes by replacing them with their child.

nodes.name: CleanupAliases
nodes.summary: Strips redundant Alias expressions left over after analysis, keeping only top-level aliases that define output names.

nodes.name: UpdateOuterReferences
nodes.summary: Rewrites outer references in subqueries to the final attributes of the outer plan after attribute deduplication.

nodes.name: RemoveTempResolvedColumn
nodes.summary: Replaces temporary TempResolvedColumn placeholders with plain attributes after the main resolution batch.

nodes.name: ResolveUnresolvedHaving
nodes.summary: Final-pass rule that converts remaining UnresolvedHaving nodes into Filter operators once their conditions are resolved.

nodes.name: AstBuilder.scala
nodes.summary: ANTLR visitor that converts a SQL parse tree into Catalyst LogicalPlan, Expression, DataType and identifier objects; it is the bridge between the parser and the analyzer. The file contains many more visitor methods (about 260 visit* methods plus helpers) than are individually represented in this graph.
nodes.languageNotes: Scala class extending the generated ANTLR visitor via DataTypeAstBuilder; every visit method is wrapped in withOrigin(ctx) to attach source positions, and Option/optional helpers are used to build plans clause by clause.

nodes.name: AstBuilder
nodes.summary: Main parser visitor class that walks the ANTLR parse tree and creates Catalyst logical plans, expressions, table identifiers and DDL/DML commands, with SQL scripting and pipe-syntax support.
nodes.languageNotes: Extends DataTypeAstBuilder and mixes in SQLConfHelper, Logging and DataTypeErrorsBase.

nodes.name: InsertTableParams
nodes.summary: Case class holding the parameters for writing a query into a table (relation, options, column list, partition spec, IF NOT EXISTS, BY NAME, replace criteria).

nodes.name: visitCompoundBodyImpl
nodes.summary: Builds a SQL scripting compound body (BEGIN ... END) from declarations and statements into a CompoundBody plan, handling variable, condition and handler declarations.

nodes.name: visitSingleStatement
nodes.summary: Parser entry point for a single SQL statement: visits the statement (or SET/RESET) context and returns the resulting LogicalPlan.

nodes.name: visitSingleExpression
nodes.summary: Parser entry point that converts a standalone expression parse tree into a Catalyst Expression via visitNamedExpression.

nodes.name: visitSingleQuery
nodes.summary: Visits a top-level query context and delegates to visitQuery to produce its LogicalPlan.

nodes.name: visitQuery
nodes.summary: Builds the plan for a full query: visits the query term, then applies CTEs and the trailing ORDER BY/LIMIT/OFFSET clauses.

nodes.name: withCTE
nodes.summary: Wraps a query plan in a With node (or recursive CTE definitions) built from the WITH clause named queries, validating recursion limits.

nodes.name: visitFromStatement
nodes.summary: Handles the FROM-first query syntax (FROM t SELECT ...) and builds the plan for each select body, including multi-select unions.

nodes.name: visitMultiInsertQuery
nodes.summary: Builds a multi-insert statement (FROM t INSERT ... INSERT ...) as a union of InsertInto plans sharing one source relation.

nodes.name: withInsertInto
nodes.summary: Wraps a query plan with the appropriate INSERT INTO / OVERWRITE target (table, directory, Hive directory, REPLACE WHERE/USING), resolving partition spec, column list and options.

nodes.name: visitInsertIntoTable
nodes.summary: Extracts InsertTableParams (target table, columns, partition spec, IF NOT EXISTS, options) from an INSERT INTO context.

nodes.name: visitDeleteFromTable
nodes.summary: Builds a DeleteFromTable plan from DELETE FROM with optional alias and WHERE condition.

nodes.name: visitUpdateTable
nodes.summary: Builds an UpdateTable plan from UPDATE ... SET assignments with optional alias and WHERE condition.

nodes.name: visitMergeIntoTable
nodes.summary: Builds a MergeIntoTable plan from MERGE INTO, parsing source, ON condition and WHEN MATCHED / NOT MATCHED / NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE actions.

nodes.name: visitPartitionSpec
nodes.summary: Converts a PARTITION (k=v, ...) clause into a map of partition column names to optional string values.

nodes.name: withQueryResultClauses
nodes.summary: Applies the optional result clauses (ORDER BY, SORT BY, CLUSTER BY, DISTRIBUTE BY, WINDOW, LIMIT, OFFSET) on top of a query plan, with variants for pipe operators.

nodes.name: visitTransformQuerySpecification
nodes.summary: Builds the plan for a SELECT TRANSFORM (script transformation) query specification, starting from the FROM clause.

nodes.name: visitRegularQuerySpecification
nodes.summary: Builds the plan for a regular SELECT query specification, resolving FROM and delegating clause handling to withSelectQuerySpecification.

nodes.name: withHavingClause
nodes.summary: Adds a Filter node for a HAVING condition on top of an aggregate plan.

nodes.name: visitCommonSelectQueryClausePlan
nodes.summary: Shared builder that layers lateral views, WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, WINDOW, QUALIFY and the select list into Project/Aggregate/Window plans.

nodes.name: visitFromClause
nodes.summary: Builds the relation tree for a FROM clause by folding comma-separated relations into joins, applying lateral views, PIVOT and UNPIVOT.

nodes.name: visitSetOperationImpl
nodes.summary: Creates a Union, Intersect or Except plan (with DISTINCT/ALL, BY NAME handling) from two child plans and a set operator token.

nodes.name: withWindowClause
nodes.summary: Resolves the named WINDOW clause definitions and substitutes them into window expressions via WithWindowDefinition.

nodes.name: withAggregationClause
nodes.summary: Builds an Aggregate plan from GROUP BY, handling plain grouping, ROLLUP/CUBE/GROUPING SETS, GROUP BY ALL and ordinal replacement.

nodes.name: withPivot
nodes.summary: Wraps a plan in a Pivot node from a PIVOT clause, parsing aggregates, pivot column and value list.

nodes.name: withUnpivot
nodes.summary: Wraps a plan in an Unpivot node from an UNPIVOT clause, handling single and multi-column value sets and null inclusion.

nodes.name: withJoinRelation
nodes.summary: Applies a JOIN clause to a left plan, resolving join type (inner, outer, semi, anti, cross, lateral), ON/USING conditions and natural joins.

nodes.name: withSample
nodes.summary: Wraps a plan in a Sample node (or limit) from TABLESAMPLE clauses by PERCENT, ROWS or BUCKET, adjusting fractions and seeds.

nodes.name: visitTableName
nodes.summary: Creates an UnresolvedRelation for a table reference, then applies alias, time travel, sampling and watermark clauses.

nodes.name: visitInlineTable
nodes.summary: Builds an UnresolvedInlineTable (or eagerly evaluated LocalRelation) from a VALUES clause with optional table alias and column names.

nodes.name: visitAliasedQuery
nodes.summary: Wraps a parenthesized subquery in a SubqueryAlias with optional column aliases and sampling.

nodes.name: visitNamedExpression
nodes.summary: Converts a select-list expression with optional alias or multi-alias into an Alias or MultiAlias Catalyst expression.

nodes.name: visitLogicalBinary
nodes.summary: Builds And/Or expressions from AND/OR predicates, flattening long chains iteratively to avoid deep recursion.

nodes.name: visitComparison
nodes.summary: Maps comparison operators (=, <=>, <>, <, <=, >, >=) to the corresponding Catalyst predicate expressions.

nodes.name: withPredicate
nodes.summary: Applies a trailing predicate (BETWEEN, IN, LIKE, RLIKE, IS NULL, IS DISTINCT FROM, ...) to a value expression, producing the right Catalyst expression with optional NOT.

nodes.name: visitArithmeticBinary
nodes.summary: Maps arithmetic and bitwise binary operators (+, -, *, /, %, DIV, &, |, ^, ||) to Catalyst expressions.

nodes.name: visitCast
nodes.summary: Builds a Cast expression from CAST(expr AS type), using TRY eval mode for TRY_CAST and tagging it as user specified.

nodes.name: visitFunctionCall
nodes.summary: Builds an UnresolvedFunction (or window expression, filter, ordering) from a function call, including named arguments, DISTINCT and the COUNT(*) rewrite.

nodes.name: visitWindowDef
nodes.summary: Builds a WindowSpecDefinition from OVER (...) with partitioning, ordering and a frame specification.

nodes.name: visitSimpleCase
nodes.summary: Builds a CaseWhen expression from a simple CASE value WHEN ... form by rewriting branches into equality comparisons.

nodes.name: visitDereference
nodes.summary: Converts a dotted reference (a.b.c) into an UnresolvedAttribute or UnresolvedExtractValue, handling regex column names.

nodes.name: visitTypeConstructor
nodes.summary: Builds typed literals such as DATE, TIMESTAMP, TIME, INTERVAL, X (binary) and other typed constants from a type-constructor expression.

nodes.name: numericLiteral
nodes.summary: Shared helper that parses a numeric literal string, range-checks it and returns a typed Literal.

nodes.name: visitInterval
nodes.summary: Builds an interval Literal, producing ANSI year-month or day-time interval types for unit-to-unit syntax and CalendarIntervalType otherwise, based on parseIntervalLiteral.

nodes.name: parseIntervalLiteral
nodes.summary: Parses multi-unit or unit-to-unit interval syntax into a Literal of CalendarIntervalType or ANSI interval type.

nodes.name: visitColDefinition
nodes.summary: Parses a single column definition (name, type, nullability, default, generated column, comment, collation, constraints) into a ColumnDefinition.

nodes.name: visitCreateTable
nodes.summary: Builds CreateTable or CreateTableAsSelect from CREATE TABLE, collecting columns, partitioning, bucketing, properties, location and provider.

nodes.name: visitOperatorPipeRightSide
nodes.summary: Handles each right-hand operator of the SQL pipe syntax (|> SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, AGGREGATE, ORDER BY, etc.) by reusing the standard clause builders on the incoming plan.

nodes.name: SparkSqlParser.scala
nodes.summary: Defines SparkSqlParser (entry point that applies variable and parameter substitution before ANTLR parsing) and SparkSqlAstBuilder, which extends the catalyst AstBuilder to turn session-level SQL commands (SET, CREATE TABLE/VIEW/FUNCTION, EXPLAIN, DESCRIBE, ADD/LIST resources, INSERT OVERWRITE DIRECTORY, pipeline datasets) into logical plans and command nodes. Only the 30 most significant of 57 functions are represented as function nodes.
nodes.languageNotes: Scala override-heavy visitor: each visitXxx method overrides a generated ANTLR visitor callback and wraps its body in withOrigin(ctx) to attach source positions to the resulting plan.

nodes.name: SparkSqlParser
nodes.summary: SQL parser used by SparkSession that extends AbstractSqlParser. It substitutes variables and query parameters into the SQL text, sets up an Origin with a position mapper for error reporting, then delegates to the ANTLR parser using SparkSqlAstBuilder.

nodes.name: SparkSqlAstBuilder
nodes.summary: Extends the catalyst AstBuilder with visitor overrides for statements that need the execution-layer (core) command classes, such as SET/RESET, CREATE TABLE/VIEW/FUNCTION, EXPLAIN, DESCRIBE, resource management and pipeline dataset definitions.
nodes.languageNotes: Subclass of a visitor generated from the SqlBase ANTLR grammar; context types such as CreateTableContext come from the wildcard import of SqlBaseParser._.

nodes.name: parseWithParameters
nodes.summary: Parses SQL text with an explicit ParameterContext, avoiding thread-local state.

nodes.name: parsePlanWithParameters
nodes.summary: Parses a SQL string into a LogicalPlan using an explicit parameter context and tracks the parameter-aware origin.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Overrides the base parse hook to route every parse through parseInternal without a parameter context.

nodes.name: parseInternal
nodes.summary: Core parsing routine: applies variable substitution, then parameter substitution (legacy or modern mode), builds an Origin with a PositionMapper and invokes the ANTLR parse inside CurrentOrigin.withOrigin.

nodes.name: extractTempFunctionName
nodes.summary: Validates and extracts the bare name of a temporary function from a multi-part identifier, rejecting qualified names and reserved namespaces.

nodes.name: normalizeTempViewIdentifier
nodes.summary: Normalizes a temporary view identifier into a TableIdentifier, enforcing that temp views use at most the session or global_temp qualifier.

nodes.name: withCatalogIdentClause
nodes.summary: Helper that evaluates an IDENTIFIER(...) clause to a name sequence and applies a builder to it, falling back to a plain multipart identifier.

nodes.name: visitSetConfiguration
nodes.summary: Builds SetCommand variants for SET statements, handling key=value, key-only and SET -v / SET forms.

nodes.name: visitSetQuotedConfiguration
nodes.summary: Handles SET with a quoted configuration key and value, producing a SetCommand.

nodes.name: visitResetConfiguration
nodes.summary: Builds ResetCommand for RESET with an optional configuration key.

nodes.name: visitSetTimeZone
nodes.summary: Translates SET TIME ZONE variants (LOCAL, interval, string) into a SetCommand for spark.sql.session.timeZone, validating zone offsets.

nodes.name: visitExplain
nodes.summary: Builds an ExplainCommand for EXPLAIN statements, selecting the explain mode and rejecting unsupported options.

nodes.name: tableIdentifier
nodes.summary: Converts a multipart name into a TableIdentifier, validating the number of parts and the catalog name.

nodes.name: visitCreateTable
nodes.summary: Handles CREATE TABLE (Hive-style and data source) by building a CreateTable or CTAS plan with storage format, partitioning and options.

nodes.name: visitCreateTempViewUsing
nodes.summary: Creates a CreateTempViewUsing command for CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW ... USING data source.

nodes.name: visitManageResource
nodes.summary: Builds AddFilesCommand, AddJarsCommand, ListFilesCommand and related plans for ADD and LIST resource statements.

nodes.name: visitCreateView
nodes.summary: Builds CreateViewCommand or CreateView for CREATE VIEW, supporting temporary and global temporary views, schema binding, column lists and comments.

nodes.name: visitCreateMetricView
nodes.summary: Builds a CreateMetricView plan for CREATE METRIC VIEW statements from the view definition and options.

nodes.name: visitCreateFunction
nodes.summary: Builds CreateFunctionCommand for CREATE FUNCTION ... AS class, parsing resources and the temporary/replace flags.

nodes.name: visitCreateUserDefinedFunction
nodes.summary: Builds plans for SQL user-defined functions (scalar and table), parsing parameters, return type, routine characteristics and body text with correct error origins.

nodes.name: visitRoutineCharacteristics
nodes.summary: Collects routine characteristics (determinism, comment, collation, language, SQL data access), checking duplicates and rejecting unsupported clauses.

nodes.name: visitDropFunction
nodes.summary: Builds a DropFunctionCommand or DropFunction plan for DROP [TEMPORARY] FUNCTION statements.

nodes.name: toStorageFormat
nodes.summary: Builds a CatalogStorageFormat from an optional location and SerdeInfo via HiveSerDe, raising a parse error for unsupported STORED AS formats.

nodes.name: visitCreateTableLike
nodes.summary: Builds a CreateTableLikeCommand for CREATE TABLE ... LIKE, carrying over provider, location and properties.

nodes.name: withScriptIOSchema
nodes.summary: Builds the ScriptInputOutputSchema for TRANSFORM clauses, resolving row formats, SerDe classes and record reader/writer settings.

nodes.name: visitInsertOverwriteDir
nodes.summary: Builds an InsertIntoDir plan for INSERT OVERWRITE DIRECTORY using a data source format.

nodes.name: visitInsertOverwriteHiveDir
nodes.summary: Builds an InsertIntoDir plan for INSERT OVERWRITE [LOCAL] DIRECTORY with Hive row format and storage settings.

nodes.name: visitDescribeRelation
nodes.summary: Builds DescribeRelation or DescribeColumn plans for DESCRIBE [EXTENDED|FORMATTED] on tables, views and columns.

nodes.name: visitCreatePipelineInsertIntoFlow
nodes.summary: Builds the logical plan for a declarative pipeline CREATE FLOW ... INSERT INTO statement.

nodes.name: visitCreatePipelineDataset
nodes.summary: Builds the logical plan for declarative pipeline dataset definitions (materialized view or streaming table), processing columns, partitioning, options and the defining query.

layers.name: Tree and Rule Foundation
layers.description: Generic Catalyst machinery: the TreeNode abstraction and the RuleExecutor that applies rule batches to trees.

layers.name: Logical and Physical Plan Model
layers.description: Shared QueryPlan base, logical operators (LogicalPlan) and physical operators (SparkPlan).

layers.name: Parsing
layers.description: Turning SQL text into an unresolved logical plan: AstBuilder converts the parse tree, and SparkSqlParser extends it for SQL commands.

layers.name: Analysis
layers.description: The Analyzer, which resolves a parsed logical plan before optimization.

layers.name: Optimization and Planning
layers.description: The optimizer that rewrites logical plans, the planner machinery and the strategies that turn them into physical plans.

layers.name: Query Execution Driver
layers.description: QueryExecution, which drives a query through the pipeline stages.

layers.name: Whole-Stage Code Generation
layers.description: The produce/consume code generation protocol and the rule that fuses operators into generated stages.

tour.title: The pipeline driver: QueryExecution
tour.description: Start here. QueryExecution exposes each stage of query processing as a member: analyzed, commandExecuted, withCachedData, optimizedPlan, sparkPlan, executedPlan and finally toRdd. It wires together the optimizer, the planner and the physical plan classes covered in the next steps.

tour.title: Everything is a tree: TreeNode and QueryPlan
tour.description: Both logical and physical plans are Catalyst trees. TreeNode provides traversal and transform APIs, which is what lets rules rewrite plans by pattern matching. QueryPlan extends TreeNode and is the base shared by logical and physical plans, adding expression transforms, subquery-aware traversal and canonicalization.

tour.title: Applying rules: RuleExecutor
tour.description: RuleExecutor runs ordered batches of rules over a tree, either once or repeatedly until a fixed point. The optimizer is built on it.

tour.title: Logical operators: LogicalPlan
tour.description: LogicalPlan is the base of all logical operators, with LeafNode, UnaryNode and BinaryNode shapes. This is the tree that analysis and optimization work on.

tour.title: From SQL text to a plan: SparkSqlParser and AstBuilder
tour.description: AstBuilder walks the parse tree and builds Catalyst logical plans and expressions through its visit methods (the graph shows 34 of the 261 it contains). SparkSqlParser holds SparkSqlAstBuilder, which extends AstBuilder to handle SQL commands. The ANTLR grammar and the generated parser are not part of this graph.

tour.title: Resolving the plan: Analyzer
tour.description: Analyzer extends RuleExecutor and runs batches of resolution rules over the logical plan. The batch order comes from earlyBatches plus the main rule list in batches (Analyzer.scala line 538). The file defines many more rules than the graph shows individually.

tour.title: Rewriting the plan: Optimizer and SparkOptimizer
tour.description: Optimizer extends RuleExecutor, and its batch list is built in defaultBatches (Optimizer.scala line 100). Some well-known rules such as ConstantFolding and ReorderJoin are not defined in this file: they live in optimizer/expressions.scala and optimizer/joins.scala. SparkOptimizer extends Optimizer and adds engine-specific batches through its own defaultBatches.

tour.title: From logical to physical: QueryPlanner, SparkPlanner and SparkStrategies
tour.description: QueryPlanner applies a list of strategies to a logical plan and expands planLater placeholders. SparkStrategies defines SparkStrategy, PlanLater and the built-in physical planning strategies (limits, joins, aggregation, windows, streaming, Python evals, basic operators). SparkPlanner extends SparkStrategies and supplies the concrete strategy order.

tour.title: Physical operators: SparkPlan
tour.description: SparkPlan is the base of physical operators, with LeafExecNode, UnaryExecNode and BinaryExecNode shapes. Its subclasses execute the query.

tour.title: Fusing operators: whole-stage code generation
tour.description: WholeStageCodegenExec compiles a pipeline of physical operators into one Java class using the CodegenSupport produce/consume protocol. The CollapseCodegenStages rule inserts these stages into a physical plan, with InputAdapter as the leaf where fusion stops.
